description: This PHP source file defines the EmailConfigurationService class within the OrangeHRM platform. It provides methods to access email configuration data (via EmailConfigurationDao) and email sending functionalities (via EmailService), including a method to send test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class for managing email configurations and sending test emails within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailConfigurationDao instance used to access email configuration data.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailService instance used for email operations.

methods.name: setEmailService
methods.description: Allows setting a specific EmailService instance, typically for dependency injection or testing.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Uses the EmailService to send a test email to the specified email address.
